It's that time again for Apple's official certified refurbished product section, and we've carefully picked out some great deals for you. This isn't a pile of battered, scratched Mac computers being sold for peanuts on eBay — these are products that have gone through Apple's "strict refurbishment process," come with the same 1-year Apple warranty as brand-new units, but are sold at lower prices.

You probably won't find AirPods Pro 3 or AirTag 2 at lower prices or historical lows, but Mac computers are available with savings of several hundred dollars, and at the most affordable prices for current-generation models. Here are this week's top picks.

Apple Refurbished Section — This Week's Picks

***Apple's certified refurbished product inventory may be very tight

Chance — MacBook Pro

My pick this week is the Apple M5 MacBook Pro lineup. The prices in Apple's certified refurbished section vary widely, starting from under US$2,000 and going up to nearly US$9,000 for the top-of-the-line configuration. There's a MacBook Pro for everyone. And one of the best reasons to choose a MacBook Pro over a MacBook Air is that stunning Liquid Retina XDR display.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: US$1,699 (original price US$1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 2TB storage and 24GB memory: US$2,719 (original price US$3,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 2TB storage and 24GB memory: US$2,969 (original price US$3,499)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 1TB storage and 48GB memory: US$3,059 (original price US$3,599)
  • 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 8TB storage and 36GB memory: US$6,029 (original price US$7,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 8TB storage and 128GB memory: US$8,499 (original price US$9,999)

Zac — Apple Watch SE 3

What's the lowest price for a brand-new Apple Watch? The most affordable current-generation certified refurbished Apple Watch Apple currently offers is this one: the 40mm GPS version of the Apple Watch SE 3, priced at US$209.

This refurbished model is US$30 cheaper than a brand-new unit with the same configuration on Amazon, and US$40 less than the original price. It will also support watchOS 27 launching this fall, making it a very worthwhile choice for users who want to pick up an Apple Watch at a reasonable price without missing out on free updates.

Justin — Apple Watch Series 11

We all love the prices of Apple's refurbished products. As Zac mentioned above, the Apple Watch SE 3 is indeed the lowest price anywhere right now, but that won't always be the case — the latest Apple Watch Series 11 is definitely not.

Consider this a friendly reminder from 9to5Toys — the Apple Watch Series 11 is discounted in Apple's refurbished section, but new units on Amazon are currently priced even lower. The 42mm Series 11 is US$339, the 46mm Series 11 is US$369, and Amazon has up to US$100 off new units for both models:

  • Apple Watch Series 11 42mm starting at US$299 (original price US$399)
  • Apple Watch Series 11 46mm starting at US$329 (original price US$429)

Ryan — MacBook Neo

If you need a new MacBook, the Neo is the model least likely to be replaced anytime soon. The MacBook Pro will be getting an M6 version later this year, and the MacBook Air should upgrade to M6 in early 2027. However, so far, news about the next-generation MacBook Neo remains very scarce. If you want the best value for money, the MacBook Neo's US$599 price tag is hard to beat. Certain professional fields may need a more powerful computer, but for the vast majority of users, the MacBook Neo should more than handle your needs.

  • MacBook Neo: US$599 (original price US$699)
  • MacBook Neo with Touch ID: US$679 (original price US$799)
